```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame
df_pandas = pd.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3],
    "jan": [100, 200, 300],
    "feb": [150, 250, 350],
    "mar": [120, 220, 320]
})

# Convert to narwhals
df = nw.from_native(df_pandas)

# Reshape from wide to long
df_long = df.unpivot(
    index="id",
    on=["jan", "feb", "mar"],
    variable_name="month",
    value_name="sales"
)

# Display result
print(df_long.to_native())
```
